strategies.text: Breaks into adds from the web hatching; keep the group on one spot and kill spiders as they spawn.
Fire-based caster; the tank takes him into the corner while casters stay out of the fire aura and interrupt where possible.
Heavy slow melee boss with a disease cloud; swap to the healer-friendly ledge and burn him.
Frost-based boss that calls frost adds at certain health marks; kill the adds fast, keep dispels and heals flowing, and avoid his freeze.

notes: Route order is a common one (Tuten'kash, Mordresh, Glutton, Amnennar); Plaguemaw the Rotting is a mini-boss/rare in the journal list with no sourced position. Belnistrasz escort quest (Extinguishing the Idol) starts near the entrance in Classic - not placed. Level range per client table. Coordinates come from OpenMap (MIT), AllTheThings or web guides only; spots those lack are null. NeedRoll (GPL-3.0) was used only to cross-check; no values were copied.
